notes.title: Steam Closed Beta Test #2 - FAQ
notes.notes:
[p]Ready for the Steam Closed Beta #2 but still have questions? Here’s everything you need to know.[/p][p][b]When does the Beta Test start and end?[/b]

The Beta Test starts September 12, at [b]07:00 UTC[/b] / [b]02:00 Central[/b] and will be available until September 15, [b]07:00 UTC[/b] / [b]02:00 Central[/b]

Stay tuned for any future tests and upcoming Beta Test announcements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's new in this test?[/b][/p][p]We've made various improvements based on your feedback from the first test and added new features as well![/p][p]Check out the full patch notes here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2964090/announcements/detail/519721290056073700"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]

[b]When do you plan to release the game on Steam?[/b]

We do not have a fixed release date just yet. Once it is ready for release on Steam, we will let you know!

[b]What are the required specs to play?[/b]
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][/p][/td][td][p][b]Minimum[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Recommended[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]OS[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64bit[/p][/td][td][p]Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64bit[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]CPU[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Intel Core i7-7700/Ryzen 5 3600[/p][/td][td][p]Intel Core i7-8700/AMD Ryzen 5 7600[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]GPU[/b][/p][/td][td][p]NVidia GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB) /AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB)[/p][/td][td][p]NVidia GeForce RTX 2060 (6GB) /AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Memory[/b][/p][/td][td][p]8 GB RAM[/p][/td][td][p]16 GB RAM[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]DirectX[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Version 12[/p][/td][td][p]Version 12[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Storage[/b][/p][/td][td][p]45 GB available space[/p][/td][td][p]45 GB available space[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
[b]Where do I sign up for the Beta Test?[/b]

Head to our Steam page and click the "Request Access" button.[/p][p]You'll receive an email from Steam if you're accepted to the Beta Test, and your application status will be visible on the Steam store page of World of Warships: Legends.[/p][p]Please note that spaces are limited and access is not guaranteed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I was part of the first beta test. Do I keep my access?[/b][/p][p]Yes, you keep your access in case you already had access during our first beta test!

[b]Will there be a progression wipe before release?[/b]

You will be able to keep your account progress from test to test, but you will start from scratch on release

[b]What platforms is the game available on?[/b]

The game is available on Xbox, PlayStation, Android, iOS, and PC (Steam beta)!

[b]Is there crossplay between the Steam, console, and mobile versions of World of Warships: Legends?[/b]

Upon release, we plan to have full crossplay between all platforms.

During the Steam Beta, you will be playing on a separate server, as there are still missing features compared to the console and mobile versions.

[b]Can I link my existing World of Warships: Legends account from console or mobile?[/b]

That is not currently supported, as we are focused on adding all features that are already present on other platforms before we can consider it. Stay tuned for any updates about it!

[b]Can I use a gamepad/controller?[/b]
While the focus is still on mouse and keyboard right now, the game now supports controllers in Port and battle, with more improvements coming in future! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Can I play World of Warships: Legends on my Steam Deck?[/b][/p][p]Yes! There is now experimental support for playing Legends on Steam Deck. We still plan to make various UI improvements in future updates, but feel free to give it a try and let us know what you think!

[b]How long are battles in World of Warships: Legends?[/b]
It varies based on the battle type, with the overall averages being around 5–8 minutes and the maximum possible battle time being 15 minutes for Standard Battles.

[b]What game modes/battle types are available?[/b]

Versus AI, Arcade, Standard, Brawl and Ranked Battles are now supported in the Steam version.[/p][p][i]Note: Some modes listed above may not be available during this Playtest[/i]

[b]Can I stream the game or create content about it?[/b]

Yes, feel free to create content about it. Please keep in mind that this is a test version and many features are still missing for parity with the already released versions on console and mobile.

The UI, controls, and general functionality of the Steam version can still change significantly until release.

[b]What are some features you expect to add?[/b]

 [/p][olist][*][p]More battle types & game modes

   [/p][/*][*][p]Account linking
 [/p][/*][*][p]And more!


Do you have other questions or would you like to share your feedback? Join our community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/wowslegends"]Discord[/url] to meet fellow players and staff.

notes.title: Captains, the next Steam Playtest is just around the corner!
notes.notes:
[p]In a week, the sluice gates will open and you'll sail out to exciting new battles with a head start, with a variety of ships of different tiers available right from the beginning.

This Playtest arrives with "The Valor Armada" September update, so you'll experience the latest build, complete with Versus AI, Standard, and Arcade Battles.[/p][p]If you joined us for the first Closed Beta Test, your hard-earned progress is safe—you'll continue exactly where you left off.  [/p][p]Even better: Once you're in, you'll be able to invite your friends to join the Playtest via Steam! Invite capacity is limited, so don't wait too long. And if you played in the first Closed Beta, you don't need an invite—you're already cleared for action.[/p][p]Wishlist us—that's how we know how many torpedoes to load![/p]

notes.title: Steam CBT #2 – Patch Notes
notes.notes:

This Playtest is part of the [b]September Update[/b], bringing content that's nearly on par with what's available on console and mobile.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what’s changed since our first Closed Beta Test:[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Progression & Account[/h2][list][*][p][b]Max account level increased to 9.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto‑login enabled[/b]: Launch the game and you’ll be signed in automatically.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay & Modes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Available battle types[/b]: Versus AI, Arcade, Standard, Brawl, Ranked
[i]Note: Some modes listed above may not be available during this Playtest.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick commands[/b]: Now available in battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Commander presets[/b]: Save and recall preferred Commander configurations.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Steam-Specific Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Steam Deck (experimental support):[/b] The game can now be launched on Steam Deck. UI improvements are planned for future updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Steam features[/b]:[/p][p]o  Rich presence – see what modes your friends are playing.
o  Recent players – track recent teammates and opponents.
o  Steam timelines – shows sunk ship markers in recorded gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Settings & UI[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Key binding customization[/b]: Full ability to remap keyboard controls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad support[/b]: Early-stage support available for Port and in-battle modes.

notes.title: Thanks for Making Waves in the First Steam CBT
notes.notes:
Captains,

This past weekend, we set sail together on our very first Steam Closed Beta Test – and what a voyage it was! Over just a few short days, you played through more than [b]11,000 battles[/b], stress-tested our systems, and helped us chart the next course forward. 

We want to give a massive thank you to everyone who participated. Your enthusiasm and feedback are helping us build a better experience on PC, and we're already working on improvements based on everything you’ve shared. 

Don’t miss what’s coming next—make sure to [b]wishlist[/b] and follow us on Steam to stay in the loop!

notes.title: Free-to-play naval war sim World of Warships Legends comes to Steam in new beta
notes.notes:
Several years ago, I spent some time playing World of Warships with a friend, and the appeal of its simulation of naval warfare was immediately apparent. The idea of learning its deep systems and mastering the controls in battles against veteran players, however, proved a little intimidating. If you fancy a more approachable alternative, I have good news; World of Warships: Legends, the war game's more newcomer-friendly sibling, is coming to PC via Steam, and the first closed beta date has just been confirmed.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: First Steam Closed Beta Test - FAQ
notes.notes:
[b]When does the Beta Test start and end?[/b]

The Beta Test starts on May 23, at 7:00 AM UTC / 2:00 AM Central and will be available until May 26, at 7:00 AM UTC / 2:00 AM Central.

Stay tuned for any future tests and upcoming Beta Test announcements.

[b]When do you plan to release the game on Steam?[/b]

We do not have a fixed release date just yet. Once it is ready for release on Steam, we will let you know!

[b]What are the required specs to play?[/b]

    Minimum:
        Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
        OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64bit
        Processor: Intel Core i7-7700/Ryzen 5 3600
        Memory: 8 GB RAM
        Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1650 (4GB) /AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB)
        DirectX: Version 12
        Network: Broadband Internet connection
        Storage: 45 GB available space

    Recommended:
        Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
        OS: Windows® 10, Windows® 11, 64bit
        Processor: Intel Core i7-8700/AMD Ryzen 5 7600
        Memory: 16 GB RAM
        Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 2060 (6GB) /AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB)
        DirectX: Version 12
        Network: Broadband Internet connection
        Storage: 45 GB available space

[b]Where do I sign up for the Beta Test?[/b]

You can head to our Steam page and click the "Request Access" button.

You will receive an email from Steam when you are accepted to the Beta Test, and you can also see the status on the Steam store page of World of Warships: Legends.

Please note that the first test will be limited and it is not guaranteed that you will receive access.

[b]Will there be a progression wipe before release?[/b]

You will be able to keep your account progress from test to test, but you will start from scratch on release

[b]What platforms is the game available on?[/b]

The game is available on Xbox, PlayStation, Android, iOS, and PC (Steam beta)!

[b]Is there crossplay between the Steam, console, and mobile versions of World of Warships: Legends?[/b]

Upon release, we plan to have full crossplay between all platforms.

During the Steam Beta, you will be playing on a separate server, as there are still missing features compared to the console and mobile versions.

[b]Can I link my existing World of Warships: Legends account from console or mobile?[/b]

That is not currently supported, as we are focused on adding all features that are already present on other platforms before we can consider it. Stay tuned for any updates about it!

[b]Can I use a gamepad/controller?[/b]
The game currently supports Xbox controllers in-battle, but not in the Port/main menu. Other controllers are not yet officially supported and may or may not work. We are mainly focused on optimizing it for mouse and keyboard controls right now.

[b]How long are battles in World of Warships: Legends?[/b]
It varies based on the battle type, with the overall averages being around 5–8 minutes and the maximum possible battle time being 15 minutes for Standard Battles.

[b]What game modes/battle types are available?[/b]

The Beta Test will have the following battle types: Versus AI, Arcade, and Standard.

[b]Can I stream the game or create content about it?[/b]

Yes, feel free to create content about it. Please keep in mind that this is a test version and many features are still missing for parity with the already released versions on console and mobile.

The UI, controls, and general functionality of the Steam version can still change significantly until release.

[b]What are some features you expect to add?[/b]

 [*]More battle types & game modes
 [*]Onboarding features (hints in battle)
 [*]Crossplay
 [*]Service Record
 [*]Calendars
 [*]Collections
 [*]Bureau
 [*]Codex (in-game help)
 [*]Fleets
 [*]Voice chat
 [*]Account linking
 [*]And more!


Do you have other questions or would you like to share your feedback? Join our community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/wowslegends]Discord[/url] to meet fellow players and staff.

Turn the tide!
